x: Forward running by Saunders, Taylor and Shields, the three very useful soldier brothers, R., E. and D. Patience, Art Allum and Jack Flower were also in good trim, and lastly had they not dug dear old Syd Warboys from his armchair?
Warboys (21), E. Saunders (22) are in faster than the words can be written!
The Belgrave men who had the honour of gaining the first set of medals ever won by the Club in the "Southern" were: Warboys 13, Footer 21, Allum 31, Duffett 37, J.

In a fast start Chantler was the best away, but was soon headed by Syd Warboys moving in his best style and taking the field along at a fast pace for about ¾ mile, when Tom Carter moved up to take the lead, followed closely by Allum, Shields, Rice and J.

Altogether we have run nine times and Bert Footer has had the distinction of representing the club on each occasion; and seven times he has run over the same stage that he covered this year. Allum, Penny and Jack Flower have each run six times; while Warboys, A.

Was glad to see Warboys out again although not showing his old-time fireworks. There seems to be no stopping the Junior element when it comes to Club Handicaps, perhaps the Handicapper has a soft spot for them, but Mewes displayed fine form in winning the 100 Yards Final off 6½ in 10 seconds dead.
Patience and Warboys. Round the triangle they go with nearly a mile of flat before they finish.
